notes.title: Fixed Spanish Game crash
notes.content: Small error caused the game to crashed due to an accidental / symbol left in the code, when reading a particular line of dialogue.

notes.title: To Make a Game OST Released!
notes.content: It took some time but I have finally added the game's soundtrack as DLC for free with the purchase of the base game. I hope you enjoy listening to the calming themes created by Lapine!

notes.title: Added Simplified Chinese
notes.content:
- Added a Simplified Chinese language option
- updated credits

notes.title: updated French translation
notes.content: Changed a few words to sound more natural in French

notes.title: Fixed game crashs for Spanish translation
notes.content: The error was using the Spanish word for "name" when the name of the variable was in English. Resulting in a crash if certain dialog options were chosen

notes.title: French Translation Hot Fix!
notes.content: Due to the great help of Sarry I was able to improve the French translation. (He also improved the font for readability in French)

notes.title: French and Spanish are now added!
notes.content: Fans have translate the game into both French and Spanish (Latin). I hope this will make the game more accessible to everyone! Please report any grammar/spelling mistakes you may find so that we can improve our game!

notes.title: Update hotfix
notes.content: removed my auto saves and cache documents
